_metadata.description: End-to-end Solace automation config for FastFulfill BV (NL). Single source of truth that drives all Logic App provisioning: Solace Cloud service, Event Portal domain/schemas/events/apps, and full broker cluster config for UAT + PROD (client profiles, ACL profiles, client usernames, 9 queues × 2 envs, topic subscriptions, REST Delivery Points). No custom code — all operations executed via Azure Logic App HTTP endpoints.

_instructions.overview: Two-phase Logic App execution provisions the full partner topology. Passwords marked <REPLACE_ME> must be substituted before submission.
_instructions.phase1_uat: HTTP POST orchestrationPayloads.uatRun → executionPlan.logicAppEndpoints.mainOrchestrator. Creates: Solace service (or reuses existing), Event Portal domain + all schemas/events/applications, UAT client profile + ACL + client username + 9 queues + subscriptions + RDP.
_instructions.phase2_prod: HTTP POST orchestrationPayloads.prodRun → executionPlan.logicAppEndpoints.mainOrchestrator. Skips Event Portal (already created). Provisions PROD cluster resources only.
_instructions.day2_crud: Use operationsCatalog entries with executionPlan.logicAppEndpoints.dispatcher for individual updates (add subscription, rotate password, update RDP host, disable username, etc.).
_instructions.credentials_init: Call executionPlan.logicAppEndpoints.credentialsInit with serviceId before cluster provisioning if using an existing service. The workflow fetches SEMP credentials and stores them in Logic App app settings.

uiFormData._comment: All field values captured from Integration Hub 3PL Onboarding UI — FastFulfill BV

common.businessObjects: materialMaster, sourcingDelivery, dispatchDelivery, returnDelivery, stockMovement, stockBalance, sourcingStock, despatchStock, returnStock
common.funcDesc: Full WMS integration suite — FastFulfill BV Netherlands. Covers 14 interfaces: master data, sourcing, dispatch, return deliveries (outbound) and stock movements, balances, confirmations (inbound).

service._comment: Solace Cloud service. Leave serviceId empty to provision new; set it to reuse an existing service (skips creation, runs credentials-init instead).
service.name: 3pl-automation-fastfulfill-nl

eventPortal.domainDescription: 3PL integration domain for FastFulfill BV (NL) — 14 WMS interfaces between 1NAV (NAV-EU-01) and the FastFulfill warehouse management system. Covers outbound deliveries (materialMaster, sourcingDelivery, dispatchDelivery, returnDelivery) and inbound stock confirmations (stockMovement, stockBalance, sourcingStock, despatchStock, returnStock).

clusterManagement._comment: Broker-level SEMP v2 config. uat and prod are submitted as separate cluster provision calls. Each creates: 1 client profile, 1 ACL profile (with direction-specific topic exceptions), 1 client username, 9 queues with subscriptions, 1 RDP with consumer + 4 outbound queue bindings.

aclProfiles.name: acl-3pl-002-uat
aclProfiles._comment_subscribe: 3PL subscribes to outbound delivery events from 1NAV

restDeliveryPoints.name: rdp-3pl-002-uat
restDeliveryPoints._comment: Delivers all outbound queue messages to FastFulfill UAT Mulesoft endpoint

restDeliveryPoints.name: rdp-3pl-002-prod
restDeliveryPoints._comment: Delivers all outbound queue messages to FastFulfill PROD Mulesoft endpoint

interfaces.funcDesc: Synchronises material master records from 1NAV to FastFulfill WMS. Triggers on CREATE, UPDATE and DELETE events in 1NAV.
Sends purchase / sourcing delivery orders from 1NAV to FastFulfill WMS for inbound goods receipt.
Sends outbound dispatch delivery orders from 1NAV sales module to FastFulfill WMS for pick, pack and ship.
Sends return delivery authorisation from 1NAV to FastFulfill WMS to receive and process returned goods.
Sends WMS-originated dispatch delivery orders from 1NAV to FastFulfill. Complements ITF_SAL_006 for direct WMS dispatch flows.
Sends WMS-originated sourcing delivery orders from 1NAV to FastFulfill. Complements ITF_PUR_028 for direct WMS inbound flows.
FastFulfill WMS publishes goods receipt stock movements back to 1NAV inventory module.
FastFulfill WMS publishes goods issue (outbound pick confirmation) stock movements back to 1NAV.
FastFulfill WMS sends hourly full stock balance snapshots to 1NAV for inventory reconciliation.
FastFulfill confirms putaway completion back to 1NAV WMS module after goods receipt at the warehouse.
FastFulfill confirms inbound purchase order receipt to 1NAV procurement module.
FastFulfill confirms despatch of goods to 1NAV sales module after pick, pack and ship completion.
FastFulfill confirms despatch to 1NAV WMS module. Complements ITF_SAL_008 for WMS-originated despatch confirmations.
FastFulfill publishes return receipt and disposition confirmation to 1NAV sales module after processing returned goods.

orchestrationPayloads._comment: Ready-to-submit HTTP request bodies. Replace all <REPLACE_ME> tokens before POST.

phase1_uatRun._description: Phase 1 — Full UAT provisioning: Solace Cloud service + Event Portal (domain, 9 schemas, 9 events, 2 apps) + UAT broker cluster (1 client profile, 1 ACL, 1 client username, 9 queues, 9 topic subscriptions, 1 RDP with 4 queue bindings).

eventPortal.domainDescription: 3PL integration domain for FastFulfill BV (NL) — 14 WMS interfaces

phase2_prodRun._description: Phase 2 — PROD cluster only. Event Portal is already provisioned. Set serviceId to the value returned by phase 1.

operationsCatalog._description: Day-2 individual CRUD operations. POST each entry body to executionPlan.logicAppEndpoints.dispatcher (or the target child workflow). All operations are idempotent — re-running create operations on existing resources returns 200/409 and the workflow continues.

operations.name: Add queue subscription
operations.description: Adds a new topic subscription to an existing queue (e.g. when a new business object is introduced).

operations.name: Rotate client username password — UAT
operations.description: Rotates the 3PL partner's UAT credential without disrupting existing sessions.

operations.name: Disable partner access — emergency
operations.description: Immediately disables the partner's client username to block all connections.

operations.name: Add ACL publish exception
operations.description: Grants the 3PL partner publish rights on a new topic namespace.

operations.name: Add ACL subscribe exception
operations.description: Grants the 3PL partner subscribe rights on a new topic namespace.

operations.name: Create new queue (new interface)
operations.description: Creates a new queue for an additional business object not in the original set.

operations.name: Update RDP consumer host — failover
operations.description: Updates the REST consumer target host for disaster recovery or endpoint migration.

operations.name: Add queue binding to RDP
operations.description: Binds a new outbound queue to the existing RDP so messages are delivered to the 3PL endpoint.

operations.name: Delete queue (decommission interface)
operations.description: Removes a queue when an interface is retired. Drain the queue before calling.

operations.name: Get service status
operations.description: Returns the current state of the Solace Cloud service.

operations.name: List all queues
operations.description: Returns all queues configured on the UAT VPN for audit or troubleshooting.

operations.name: Get client username details
operations.description: Returns configuration and status of the 3PL partner's PROD credential.

operations.name: Export current config (clone baseline)
operations.description: Exports the live service config to JSON for auditing or cloning to a new country/region.

executionPlan._description: Step-by-step provisioning guide. Each phase maps to a Logic App HTTP POST. Phases run sequentially — wait for each phase to return HTTP 200 before proceeding.

logicAppEndpoints._comment: Deployed Azure Logic App trigger URLs — from solace-automation/azure-logic-apps/deployed-urls.json

phases.name: Credentials Init (existing service only)
phases.description: Skip if provisioning a new service — the main-orchestrator handles this automatically. Run only when onboarding onto an existing Solace Cloud service.

phases.name: UAT Full Provision
phases.description: Submits orchestrationPayloads.phase1_uatRun to the main-orchestrator. Internally the orchestrator runs: (1a) Service create + poll ready, (1b) SEMP credentials init, (1c) Event Portal domain + schemas + events + apps, (1d) UAT cluster — client profile, ACL profile, client username, 9 queues with subscriptions, RDP with consumer + 4 queue bindings.

phases.name: PROD Cluster Provision
phases.description: Submits orchestrationPayloads.phase2_prodRun. Replace <SERVICE_ID_FROM_PHASE1> with the serviceId from phase 1 response. Event Portal is skipped. Creates PROD client profile, ACL profile, client username, 9 PROD queues with subscriptions, PROD RDP.

phases.name: Validation — UAT
phases.description: Verify all UAT resources are correctly provisioned. Check queues, ACL, and RDP status.

phases.name: Validation — PROD
phases.description: Verify all PROD resources are provisioned correctly before handing connection details to the partner.

phases.name: Hand-off — deliver connection details to partner
phases.description: Provide FastFulfill with the broker URL, VPN names, client usernames, passwords, and topic/queue reference. No Logic App call — manual step.
